flows.title: Add a source
steps: Go to Connections and click Add Source.
Click the source to add, such as a JavaScript website, then click Add Source.
Enter a name for the source and any information the setup page asks for.

flows.title: Add a destination
steps: From the workspace, click Add destination. It is on the Connections home page, the Destinations list and each Source overview page.
Search for the destination in the Catalog and click its tile, then click Configure on the summary page.
Choose which source sends data to it, and click Confirm source.

In the Connection Settings that appear, enter any required fields. Segment's page says these might be a key or token issued by the destination tool, an account ID, or a prompt to log in to that tool. If needed, click the toggle to enable the destination so it starts receiving data.

flows.title: Invite team members
steps: Go to Settings > Workspace Settings and click the Access Management tab.
Enter the team members' email addresses, separated by commas. Optionally add them to user groups, or give individual roles to all the invites.
